skills.skill_desc: Balmond recovers 5% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> upon killing a minion or creep, and 10% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> upon a hero kill or assist.

Balmond charges in the target direction, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way.
He stops upon hitting an enemy hero, knocking them back and slowing them by 40% for 3s.

Balmond gains 15% Movement Speed and spins with his axe for 3s, dealing 30<font color="26e407"> (+1.3% Max HP)</font> <font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> per hit to nearby enemies up to 14 times.

Each hit reduces the target's <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> by 5% (up to 40%).

Balmond unleashes a powerful strike in a target direction, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> (+ 30% of the target's <font color="26e407">lost <1997></font>) as <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font>. This skill can only be interrupted by <font color="a6aafb">Suppression</font>.

Damage dealt to non-hero units is capped at 1000 <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font>.
